## Standards checklist

See [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and
[`docs/AGENT_CHECKLIST.md`](../docs/AGENT_CHECKLIST.md).

- [ ] Uses Material 3 widgets and theme tokens (no hard-coded colours, font
      sizes or magic spacing numbers)
- [ ] Fully responsive: no overflow at 320, 600, 840 and 1200 px, portrait and
      landscape, light and dark
- [ ] No `dart:io` in shared code; works on mobile, web and desktop
- [ ] Meaningful names; widgets are classes, not helper methods
- [ ] `///` documentation on every new public member
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `dart format .`, `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/` updated where relevant
